program: Health Facilities Enhancement Program (HFEP), Department of Health
matching_note: Per-document stages with a reviewable cross-document comparison. The House Volume I-B annex and the NEP Volume II-A annex both include national and LGU facilities. Compare HFEP capital-outlay schedules at their retained funding-column grain; pairings are provisional, so rows are matched only as reviewable title-similarity suggestions and never merged.
compare_note: Column reconciliation compares printed per-column annex controls (always meaningful). Line-item pairs are suggestions for human review: similarity >= 0.95 on normalized titles within the same region and province. Per-column deltas on pairs are shown as printed; unmatched rows stay unmatched rather than zero.

comparison.pairs_note: Pairs are title-similarity suggestions for review, not asserted identities. Similarity is computed on normalized titles within the same (region, province) block; every pair carries its score and both source row ids. Rows may be the same facility with OCR label variants, and House rows without an NEP counterpart typically reflect the two annexes recording different grains, not omissions.
